slides.title: Deterministic Guardrail Sieve: Zero-Hallucination Guarantee
slides.notes: Grammar-constrained logits masking enforces strict JSON schema and zero hallucination.

elements.content: Context-free grammar (CFG) masks out invalid vocabulary logits before sampling, guaranteeing 100% syntactically valid outputs.

Raw probability distribution over entire vocabulary:

• "{": 42.1%
• "Sure": 28.4% (Hallucination risk)
• "```": 14.2% (Markdown noise)
• "Hello": 8.1% (Chat chatter)

Without guardrails, non-deterministic chatter breaks parser.

Real-time state machine enforces grammar:

• Mask: ["Sure", "```", "Hello"] set to -inf
• Allowed: Only tokens satisfying schema
• Bitmask computed in 0.04ms on GPU
• Zero round-trip validation re-prompts

Streamed token strictly satisfies Pydantic:

{
  "action": "execute_trade",
  "shares": 500,
  "symbol": "AAPL",
  "confidence": 0.992
}

Guaranteed compile-time parseable.
PRODUCTION COMPLIANCE GUARANTEE: Zero JSON Retry Loops • Zero SQL Injection
Eliminates retry loops that waste 22% of token costs in unconstrained LLM deployments. 100% first-pass schema accuracy.
